name: flatironinstitute__inferelator
root_api: the .A attribute of scipy.sparse spmatrix and sparray
behavioral_change: Whole-snapshot upgrade of pandas 2.0.3 to 2.3.1, numpy 1.25.0 to 2.3.2, scipy 1.11.1 to 1.16.1 and anndata 0.9.1 to 0.12.1 (resolved values); the root API label records scipy 1.11.1 to 1.16.1 as primary with the removal of the sparse .A attribute (_spbase.A). The behavioral component is that the row order of a pandas merge result is no longer stable, mixed with many interface renames.
downstream_effect: Only 1 of 412 scored tests fails: test_result_processor_random asserts a score of 0.406 where 0.378 is expected, because the multi-task result processor computes a shifted score from the reordered rows; no exception is raised and the traceback gives no direct clue.
reference_fix: Replaces the sparse-matrix `.A` attribute with `.toarray()` across `inferelator/preprocessing/data_normalization.py`, `inferelator/preprocessing/velocity.py`, `inferelator/regression/mi.py`, `inferelator/tfa/ridge_tfa.py`, `inferelator/utils/data.py` and `inferelator/utils/inferelator_data.py` (using `np.array(...)` for `sum`/`mean` results), changes `ad.read(model)` to `ad.read_h5ad(model)` in `inferelator/predict/static.py`, and in `inferelator/postprocessing/model_performance.py` replaces `np.NaN` with `np.nan` and adds `confidence_idx`/`gold_idx` columns to sort the outer join result before dropping them.

upgrade.note: TimeMachine-bench case: every dependency is resolved at the dated snapshot; the library at v_old/v_new is the one whose behavioral change breaks the tests.
